title: Vehicle Attachment
description: Canonical, app-owned vehicle-attachment record (SHIPYARD Y3d, ruling shipyard-y3d-census Contract 1). Ingested ONCE from OggDude's itemattachments Type='Vehicle' (120). base_mods/added_mods are DISPLAY prose. SHIP YARD S3 (R-S3K-4) adds the ENCODED form beside them: base_effects, pool_mods (pool_upgrades until F-100 M8's fold, R-M8C8-2) and added_options, written only for keyed mods the book agrees with. hp is null-HONEST: null = source lists no hard-point cost (24 entries), never defaulted to 0.

hp.description: Hard-point install COST; null = the source lists none — never defaulted to 0 (no-fake-precision).

hp_note.description: The book's own words when the hard-point cost is conditional (Upgraded Weapons, EotE p.271: 0 when replacing, 1 when adding). `hp` then holds the adding cost.

price_per_silhouette.description: R-S4WB-6 (ruling shipyard-s4-workbench): the books price this part PER POINT OF SILHOUETTE (FaD Table 7-15, "2,000 x silhouette"; FaD p.269–270), so `price` is the printed base and a hull's list price is price × its silhouette, read at ONE place (lib/shared/vesselView.jsx listPrice). Present only where OggDude's ItemAttachment carries <PriceSizeMult>true</PriceSizeMult>; absent = a flat price.

price_per_passenger.description: R-S5R-3 (ruling shipyard-s5-ready, B-1025): the book prices this part PER PASSENGER ("Price: 2,000 credits times the vehicle's passenger capacity", Desperate Allies p.65), so `price` is the printed base and a ship's list price is price × its passenger capacity, read at ONE place (lib/shared/vesselView.jsx listPrice); a 0 or null capacity gives no price, no sale (R-S5R-4). Present only where OggDude's ItemAttachment carries <PricePassMult>true</PricePassMult>; at most one price_per_* flag per row.

price_per_laser_weapon.description: R-S5R-3/16 (ruling shipyard-s5-ready, B-1025): the book prices this part PER LASER WEAPON ("3,000 credits per laser weapon enhanced", Special Modifications p.66; Table 2-11 p.67's 5,000 is named in the row's cite, DECISIONS D-45), so `price` is the printed base and a ship's list price is price × the count of its weapons whose category is exactly "Laser" (public/data/canonical/vehicle_weapon_categories.vocab.json; null is not a laser), read at ONE place (lib/shared/vesselView.jsx listPrice); zero lasers gives no price, no sale (R-S5R-4). Present only where OggDude's ItemAttachment carries <PriceWeponCatMult>Laser</PriceWeponCatMult>; at most one price_per_* flag per row.

allOf.$comment: R-M8C8-1: id, per_rank, cite and words are TALENT rows only; a part REFUSES them.
R-M8C8-3: weapon_quality_delta is a TALENT-only op; a part REFUSES it (a part that needs it lifts this in its own ruling).

base_effects.description: SHIP YARD S3 K3: the base mods ENCODED — only those the printed-text check agreed with (data-sources/vehicle_attachment_print_check.json).

pool_mods.description: SHIP YARD (R-M8C8-2): a dice UPGRADE this part gives the crew member rolling that skill from their seat (R-S3K-4); C3's family (R-M8K-3), on a part only upgrade · ability · one skill, until another verb enters with its arm (R-S1RJ-5).

added_options.description: SHIP YARD S3 K3 + AM-1: one entry per AddedMods line, in order (index-aligned with added_mods). `id` is STABLE — the OggDude mod Key, else a slug of the printed text — and a saved install names it (InstalledAttachment.mods[].option); `max` is the printed count (EotE p.187).

talent_grant.description: THE SURFACING MISSION (R-SYC-5, card f100-surfacing-yard-concept ADDENDUM 2 Q3): the talent this option grants whoever uses the system, a talents.json id; vesselResolve projects it on out.seat_talents, never saved.

allOf.$comment: R-M8C8-1: id, per_rank, cite and words are TALENT rows only; a part REFUSES them.
R-M8C8-3: weapon_quality_delta is a TALENT-only op; a part REFUSES it (a part that needs it lifts this in its own ruling).

pool_mods.description: SHIP YARD (R-M8C8-2): a dice UPGRADE this part gives the crew member rolling that skill from their seat (R-S3K-4); C3's family (R-M8K-3), on a part only upgrade · ability · one skill, until another verb enters with its arm (R-S1RJ-5).

prints.description: R-S3K-7: present when any effect line of the row is NOT encoded — one line saying why, by class.

cite.description: Printed-page cite for text taken from the book rather than OggDude (B-924), or for a number the book decides (R-S3CR-3's counts; R-S4WB-6's per-silhouette price; R-S5R-3's per-passenger and per-laser prices).

constraints.description: RAW install limits (carried as data; the UI may filter/annotate, the registry never drops for them).

must_not_be_starship.description: SHIP YARD S8 (ruling f100-s8-vocabulary R-S8V-3): the inverse of must_be_starship, read where it is read (vesselStore resolveFit) against the row's `is_starship` (a library row's, or a frame row's). "This engine type cannot be mounted on starships" (Fully Operational p.82, the High-Performance Repulsor Cluster).

kind.description: SHIP YARD S8 (card shipyard-s8-build R-S8B-3; ruling shipyard-s8-census-card R-S8C-8): what the record IS when it is not an ordinary part — a crafting core component (engine | hull, Fully Operational pp.81-84) or a conversion template (Dangerous Covenants p.71). Absent = an ordinary part. The ONE offer rule (lib/shared/vesselStore.js `offerable`) offers only kind-less rows; a saved ship that holds a kinded one keeps it.

defense_picks.description: SHIP YARD S8 (card shipyard-s8-build R-S8B-5 + ADDENDUM 2 Q3; ruling shipyard-s8-census-card R-S8C-10): a conversion template only — how many arcs the GM picks for its "+1" defense (DC p.71: "the GM decides which arc the increase applies to"); its ONE chosen defense_delta applies once per pick, pick i into the ship's conversion.arcs[i]. Absent = no pick.

_provenance.description: oggdude = ingested; book = a row OggDude does not carry, written from the cited page (B-924).
